focus: Angle 5: agents, subagents, commands and goal
noveltyJustification: Seven findings are new (mount inventory, persona lever, preset scope, subagent schema, command plane, goal semantics, plan-mode risk); two reframe known Pi/Hermes precedent as missing harness features.
answeredQuestions: How can this repo's agents, subagents, commands and goal binding be reached by the harness?
ruledOut: Plan mode as an unattended gate

label: The base bundle already mounts goal, goal-round-driver, command-goal, plan-mode, tool-goal, both in-process subagent providers, subagent and control tools, the workflow engine and tool, skill-filesystem and tool-skill; headless inherits all of it and disables only HMR, credentials, authorization and deepseek-account.
Headless agent identity is the system-prompt row's personaPrefix, shipped as a one-line coding persona and replaceable by a --patch overlay; no agent-file loader scans .skilled/agents or .dsh/agents.

Presets are declarative agent-preset rows with id and plugins mounted beside agent-preset-registry, with a persona row per composition; definitions are plugin rows rather than scanned directories and the registry is mounted by web-app, not by base or headless.

The subagent tool takes description, prompt, optional name and cwd; a child preset is selectable only through agent_preset when allowedAgentPresets is configured, and there is no persona-file argument.

Human commands are plugin registrations on ctx.commands that dispatch without a model turn; there is no filesystem command loader, and headless without a command adapter cannot use /goal, so .skilled/commands must be composed into prompts by the dispatcher.

The goal service keeps one goal per session with compare-and-set updates, a 256-round default cap and human-authority create/edit; nothing reads goal.md, so a packet goal needs a plugin hook or explicit instructions that call create_goal.
The goal round driver auto-continues an active goal while idle, so an unattended headless dispatch could run up to 256 extra rounds past a lineage timeout unless goals are avoided or capped low.

Plan mode is mounted in base but exit_plan_mode presents over the user-questions seam and fails closed without an interactive review; headless has no live approval channel, so plan mode must stay off in unattended dispatches.

Pi and Hermes expose commands as prompt templates and agents as mirrored files or persona skills; the harness has no --prompt-template or agent flag, so those surfaces must be carried by the dispatch builder and the skill catalog.

reason: No such loader or flag exists; personas come from system-prompt, presets or the prompt body.
The command plane is plugin-registered and headless has no command adapter.

direction: Plan mode as an unattended gate
reason: exit_plan_mode fails closed without an interactive review, which headless does not provide.
